title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,551–2,600 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Taiwan plays an indispensable pivotal role in the global tech supply chain.
examples.zh: 台灣在全球高科技供應鏈中扮演著不可或缺的關鍵樞紐角色。

examples.en: Geopolitical tensions have forced multinational corporations to diversify their supply chains.
examples.zh: 地緣政治緊張局勢迫使跨國企業積極推動供應鏈多元化分散風險。

examples.en: Severe semiconductor shortages disrupted automobile supply chains worldwide.
examples.zh: 嚴重的半導體晶片短缺打亂了全球汽車產業的正常供應鏈運作。

examples.en: Efficient warehousing logistics ensures same-day parcel delivery across the island.
examples.zh: 高效的倉儲物流管理確保了全島當日配送到府服務。

examples.en: The company invested millions of dollars to upgrade its international cold-chain logistics.
examples.zh: 該公司投入數百萬美元資金全面升級其國際冷鏈物流系統。

examples.en: Poor logistics planning can lead to delayed deliveries and dissatisfied customers.
examples.zh: 不良的物流規劃往往會導致出貨嚴重延誤並招致顧客強烈不滿。

examples.en: Air freight is preferred for transporting urgent temperature-sensitive microchips.
examples.zh: 急需且對溫度敏感的晶片零件首選採用航空貨運方式運送。

examples.en: Rising ocean freight rates significantly increased the retail prices of imported goods.
examples.zh: 遠洋海運貨運費率的飆漲大幅推升了各類進口商品的零售價格。

examples.en: The logistics carrier offers door-to-door freight forwarding services for industrial machinery.
examples.zh: 該物流承運商為大型工業機械設備提供到府門對門的貨運承攬轉運服務。

examples.en: The massive cargo vessel carried thousands of standard twenty-foot containers.
examples.zh: 這艘巨型貨櫃輪裝載了數千只二十呎標準貨櫃。

examples.en: Airport workers carefully inspected the international cargo for hazardous undeclared chemicals.
examples.zh: 機場地勤人員嚴密查驗該批國際貨物，以防夾帶未申報的危險化學品。

examples.en: The ship unloaded its cargo of Australian wheat at Taichung Port yesterday.
examples.zh: 這艘散裝貨輪昨日在台中港碼頭順利卸下了滿載的澳洲進口小麥。

examples.en: Standardized shipping containers revolutionized modern international ocean trade.
examples.zh: 標準化海運貨櫃徹底革新了現代國際遠洋貿易史。

examples.en: Put the leftover food in an airtight plastic container before placing it in the fridge.
examples.zh: 請在將剩菜剩飯放入冰箱保鮮之前，先裝進密封保鮮容器中。

examples.en: Port workers operated giant gantry cranes to stack hundreds of steel containers.
examples.zh: 港口碼頭工人熟練操作巨型門式起重機，將數百只鋼製貨櫃整齊堆疊。

examples.en: Kaohsiung Harbor is Taiwan's largest commercial port of entry.
examples.zh: 高雄港是全台灣吞吐量最大的國際商務通商港口。

examples.en: All passengers arriving from abroad must pass through border customs at their port of entry.
examples.zh: 所有由海外抵達的旅客都必須在入境通商口岸依規定通過邊境海關查驗。

examples.en: Strict agricultural quarantine checks are enforced at every designated port of entry.
examples.zh: 政府在每一處指定的入出境口岸均嚴格執行各項動植物防檢疫措施。

words.definition: 大型貨船；船艦；血管；容器

examples.en: The giant container vessel docked smoothly at Keelung Port this morning.
examples.zh: 巨型貨櫃船今晨平穩順利停靠於基隆港碼頭。

examples.en: High blood pressure can cause microscopic damage to delicate blood vessels over time.
examples.zh: 長期罹患高血壓可能會對人體微細脆弱的血管造成難以察覺的慢性損害。

examples.en: The Coast Guard dispatched a rescue patrol vessel to assist the stranded fishing boat.
examples.zh: 海巡署緊急派出巡邏搜救船艦前往外海馳援失去動力的受困漁船。

words.definition: 關稅；進口關稅率；價目表

examples.en: Governments impose import tariffs to protect domestic agricultural industries.
examples.zh: 各國政府透過課徵進口關稅以保護本土農產品產業。

examples.en: The bilateral trade treaty gradually eliminates customs tariffs on thousands of industrial goods.
examples.zh: 這項雙邊經貿協定將逐步分期取消數千項工業產品的進口海關關稅。

examples.en: Heavy punitive tariffs were placed on imported steel products to counter dumping.
examples.zh: 政府對低價進口鋼鐵製品課徵高額懲罰性關稅，以反制海外惡意傾銷行為。

examples.en: Electronic customs clearance speeds up international parcel processing.
examples.zh: 電子化線上報關能大幅加速國際網購包裹的通關時程。

examples.en: Missing commercial documents delayed the customs clearance of the electronic shipment.
examples.zh: 缺少必備商業單據導致這批電子零件貨件的通關審驗流程嚴重延宕。

examples.en: The express courier offers expedited customs clearance for cross-border e-commerce orders.
examples.zh: 快捷快遞公司為各類跨境電商零售包裹提供急速通關的專業便捷服務。

examples.en: The licensed customs broker assisted the exporter with paperwork filing.
examples.zh: 領有執照的專業報關行協助出口商完成各項報關文件申報。

examples.en: Hiring an experienced customs broker minimizes unexpected import delays and penalty fines.
examples.zh: 委託經驗豐富的報關行能將進口過程中的無預警延誤與法規罰款降至最低。

examples.en: Our customs broker advised us on the proper commodity classification codes for the new gadgets.
examples.zh: 我們的報關行針對這批新上市科技產品的正確商品海關稅則號列提供了專業諮詢。

examples.en: The shipping company released the cargo upon receiving the original bill of lading.
examples.zh: 航運公司在收到正本海運提單（B/L）後正式放行貨物。

examples.en: The ocean bill of lading serves as a title of ownership and a contract of carriage.
examples.zh: 海運提單具備貨物物權所有權憑證以及海上運輸運送契約的雙重法律效力。

examples.en: Always verify that the quantities on the commercial invoice match the bill of lading exactly.
examples.zh: 務必仔細核對商業發票上的商品數量是否與提單上所列明細完全一致。

examples.en: The commercial invoice specifies unit pricing, quantities, and total valuation.
examples.zh: 商業發票上清楚詳載了商品的單價、數量與申報總金額。

examples.en: Customs inspectors rejected the shipment because the commercial invoice was not signed.
examples.zh: 由於商業發票上欠缺負責人親筆簽章，海關檢驗官員當場退回了該批貨物。

examples.en: Sellers must attach three copies of the commercial invoice to the outer packing carton.
examples.zh: 賣方必須依海關規定在最外層的外包裝紙箱牢固附上三份正本商業發票。

examples.en: Customs inspectors checked gross weights against the official packing list.
examples.zh: 海關查驗官員依據官方裝箱明細單逐一核對各箱總毛重。

examples.en: The detailed packing list enumerates the net weight and dimensions of every single crate.
examples.zh: 詳盡的裝箱明細表逐一列明了每一個包裝木箱的淨重以及外箱長寬高尺寸。

examples.en: Please email me the warehouse packing list so our receiving team can prepare storage space.
examples.zh: 請先將出庫裝箱明細單寄至我的信箱，好讓我們的收貨驗收組預留倉儲空間。

examples.en: Importers presented a certificate of origin to qualify for tariff discounts.
examples.zh: 進口商出具了原產地證明書（C/O）以爭取適用優惠關稅減免。

examples.en: The local chamber of commerce issued a certified certificate of origin for the agricultural produce.
examples.zh: 當地商工總會針對這批在地農特產品正式核發了具法定效力的原產地證明書。

examples.en: Without a valid certificate of origin, your goods may be denied preferential duty treatment.
examples.zh: 若未能出具有效合規的原產地證明，您的貨物恐將無法享受優惠關稅待遇。

examples.en: Imported luxury electronics are subject to customs duty and value-added tax.
examples.zh: 進口的高價精品電子產品須依規定繳納海關關稅與營業稅。

examples.en: It is every responsible citizen's fundamental civic duty to vote in general elections.
examples.zh: 積極參與各項大選投票是每位克盡己責的現代公民最核心基本的公民義務。

examples.en: A dedicated nurse was on duty in the intensive care unit throughout the midnight shift.
examples.zh: 一名盡忠職守的專責護理師在整個大夜班輪值期間全程守護加護病房病患。

examples.en: High tariffs and strict quotas act as restrictive international trade barriers.
examples.zh: 高額關稅與嚴格配額構成了具限制性的國際貿易壁壘。

examples.en: The international trade agreement aims to dismantle unnecessary regulatory trade barriers.
examples.zh: 該國際經貿協定的終極目標旨在破除不必要且繁瑣的各項行政管制貿易壁壘。

examples.en: Subsidies given to local producers can sometimes create unfair technical trade barriers.
examples.zh: 政府對本國製造商所發放的巨額專案補貼，有時會形成不公平的技術性貿易壁壘。

examples.en: Signing bilateral free trade agreements (FTAs) boosts cross-border commerce.
examples.zh: 簽署雙邊自由貿易協定（FTA）能顯著促進跨國經貿繁榮發展。

examples.en: The proposed free trade agreement will eliminate import quotas between both neighboring nations.
examples.zh: 這項研議中的自由貿易協定將全面撤除鄰近兩國之間長年存在的進口配額限制。

examples.en: Economists predict that the comprehensive free trade agreement will create thousands of export jobs.
examples.zh: 經濟學家樂觀預測，該項全方位自由貿易協定將為外銷產業創造數千個工作機會。

examples.en: Taiwan became an official member of the World Trade Organization (WTO) in 2002.
examples.zh: 台灣於 2002 年正式加入世界貿易組織（WTO）成為會員。

examples.en: The World Trade Organization settles complex trade disputes among member states.
examples.zh: 世界貿易組織肩負公正調解與裁決會員國之間複雜跨國經貿爭端之重責大任。

examples.en: Multilateral tariff reduction negotiations are conducted within the World Trade Organization framework.
examples.zh: 涉及眾多國家的多邊關稅調降回合談判，皆在世界貿易組織的法規架構下進行。

examples.en: Cross-border e-commerce enables Taiwanese brands to sell directly to global shoppers.
examples.zh: 跨境電子商務讓台灣本土優質品牌能直接行銷全球消費者。

examples.en: Cross-border payments have become faster and cheaper thanks to innovative financial technology.
examples.zh: 得益於創新金融科技的飛速發展，跨境資金匯款支付變得更為迅捷且手續費低廉。

examples.en: Police forces from both jurisdictions collaborated closely to crack down on cross-border fraud rings.
examples.zh: 兩地檢警執法單位展開跨國緊密偵查合作，聯手徹底瓦解了大型跨境跨國詐騙集團。

words.definition: 倉儲履約中心；電商發貨中心

examples.en: Automated fulfillment centers pack thousands of online orders every hour.
examples.zh: 自動化電商倉儲履約中心每小時能高效揀貨包裝數千筆線上訂單。

examples.en: The global retail giant built a state-of-the-art fulfillment center near Taoyuan International Airport.
examples.zh: 這家全球零售巨擘在桃園國際機場周邊興建了一座具備尖端設備的倉儲物流履約中心。

examples.en: Advanced robotic sorters move heavy palettes inside the smart fulfillment center.
examples.zh: 先進智慧搬運揀貨機器人在這座現代化履約中心內部靈活穿梭搬運沉重的貨物棧板。

words.definition: 物流配送中心；物流總倉

examples.en: Trucks depart from the northern distribution center to restock retail branches.
examples.zh: 大貨車每日清晨由北部物流配送中心出發為各連鎖分店補貨。

examples.en: The central distribution center coordinates inventory supply for over one hundred supermarkets.
examples.zh: 位於中部的物流總倉統籌調度並配送全台一百多家連鎖超級市場的貨架庫存。

examples.en: Heavy seasonal snowstorms temporarily halted shipments leaving the regional distribution center.
examples.zh: 突如其來的嚴重暴風雪一度迫使該區域物流中心對外發車的所有長途車隊暫停出車。

words.definition: 最後一哩路配送；末端配送

examples.en: Electric scooters make eco-friendly last-mile delivery possible in congested cities.
examples.zh: 電動機車讓擁擠都會區中環保快捷的最後一哩路配送成為可能。

examples.en: High fuel costs and urban traffic jams account for most of the expenses in last-mile delivery.
examples.zh: 高昂的燃油成本與市區尖峰大塞車構成了末端配送環節中最龐大的物流開銷。

examples.en: Many courier companies are experimenting with autonomous delivery drones for last-mile delivery.
examples.zh: 眾多國際快遞公司正積極測試利用自動飛行無人機來落實偏遠地區的最後一哩配送。

examples.en: The express courier delivered the signed legal documents within two hours.
examples.zh: 快捷快遞員在兩小時內將簽署好的法律文件迅速送達。

examples.en: She entrusted the irreplaceable antique necklace to a bonded international courier.
examples.zh: 她將那條價值連城且不可替代的古董項鍊託付給受保額保障的國際專業快遞。

examples.en: The company hired a private motorcycle courier to transport urgent medical specimens to the lab.
examples.zh: 該生技公司專程聘請機車快遞員將急需檢驗的醫療檢體以最快速度送達化驗室。

examples.en: Enter your twelve-digit parcel tracking number online to check status.
examples.zh: 在線上輸入您的十二碼包裹追蹤號碼以即時查詢配送進度。

examples.en: Customers immediately receive a tracking number via email as soon as the item ships out.
examples.zh: 只要商品一完成出貨打包，顧客就會立刻透過電子郵件收到專屬的物流追蹤碼。

examples.en: The customer service representative traced the delayed package using the unique tracking number.
examples.zh: 客服專員利用這組獨一無二的貨運追蹤單號，迅速查詢定位到了運送延誤的包裹。

examples.en: Your online book order is currently in transit and arrives tomorrow.
examples.zh: 您在網路書店訂購的書籍目前正在運送途中，預計明日送達。

examples.en: The delicate fragile crystal vase was unfortunately damaged while in transit.
examples.zh: 那只做工精巧易碎的水晶花瓶非常不幸地在長途貨運途中遭受了碰撞碎裂。

examples.en: Fresh strawberries must be kept cold in transit to prevent early spoilage.
examples.zh: 剛採摘的新鮮草莓在長途運輸途中必須全程維持低溫冷藏，以防果肉提早腐爛變質。

examples.en: The tracking page shows the package is out for delivery today.
examples.zh: 物流追蹤頁面顯示該包裹今天已經由外送員出車派送中。

examples.en: Please make sure someone is at home because your parcel is currently out for delivery.
examples.zh: 請確保家中有人能夠簽收，因為您的貴重掛號包裹目前司機已出車派送中。

examples.en: The delivery driver sent a text message alerting the recipient that the order was out for delivery.
examples.zh: 物流司機在出發前發送了一則簡訊，溫馨提醒收件人所訂購的商品今日即將送達。

examples.en: The package was successfully delivered to your neighborhood convenience store.
examples.zh: 包裹已成功送達您指定的社區巷口便利商店以供取件。

examples.en: All purchased furniture pieces were delivered and assembled by technicians in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 所有訂購的居家大型家具已於午後由專業技師順利送達並現場組裝完畢。

examples.en: The keynote speaker delivered an inspiring address to thousands of university graduates.
examples.zh: 受邀的主講嘉賓在畢業典禮上向數千名即將步入社會的大學畢業生發表了鼓舞人心的演講。

examples.en: E-commerce platforms offer hassle-free seven-day merchandise return services.
examples.zh: 電商平台提供七天鑑賞期內輕鬆便捷的無條件退換貨服務。

examples.en: The investor expects a substantial financial return on this renewable energy project.
examples.zh: 該名投資者殷切期望這項大型再生能源投資專案能帶來豐厚且穩健的投資報酬率。

examples.en: She promised to return the borrowed library books before the weekend due date.
examples.zh: 她信守承諾，在週末到期日截止前親自將所有向公立圖書館借閱的藏書歸還。

examples.en: The strategic procurement department negotiates bulk raw material discounts.
examples.zh: 策略採購部門負責洽談大宗原物料採購的批量折扣優惠。

examples.en: Transparent government procurement rules prevent bribery and encourage fair market competition.
examples.zh: 公開透明的政府機關採購法規能有效防杜私相收受賄賂，並促進自由市場良性競爭。

examples.en: She holds extensive professional expertise in global semiconductor parts procurement.
examples.zh: 她在全球半導體零組件戰略採購領域深耕多年，累積了極為深厚專業的採辦經驗。

examples.en: Establishing long-term mutual trust with key component suppliers is vital.
examples.zh: 與核心零組件供應商建立長期互信合作關係至關重要。

examples.en: The company terminated its contract with the overseas supplier due to chronic quality defects.
examples.zh: 由於海外供貨廠商長期存在嚴重品質瑕疵，該公司最終決定斷然終止合作合約。

examples.en: Finding an alternative supplier of clean industrial chemicals proved to be difficult.
examples.zh: 要在短時間內尋覓到另一家具備合格認證的純淨工業化學品替代供應商實屬不易。

examples.en: The tech corporation invited approved software vendors to bid on the contract.
examples.zh: 這家科技大廠邀請了合格的軟體廠商就該合約專案進行投標。

examples.en: Street food vendors in Taiwanese night markets sell delicious braised pork rice and oyster omelets.
examples.zh: 台灣各大知名夜市的街頭小吃攤販熱情叫賣著香氣撲鼻的滷肉飯與美味蚵仔煎。

examples.en: We need to evaluate three different cloud storage vendors before making a final procurement decision.
examples.zh: 在拍板定案最終採購決策前，我們必須審慎綜合評估三家不同雲端儲存服務廠商的提案。

examples.en: Extreme typhoons caused severe disruptions to international sea cargo.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風對國際遠洋海運貨物運送造成了嚴重的斷鏈與延誤。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is creating profound disruption across the financial and healthcare industries.
examples.zh: 人工智慧的突飛猛進正對全球金融界與醫療保健產業帶來翻天覆地的深遠顛覆性變革。

examples.en: A sudden strike by dock workers brought about widespread disruption to port loading operations.
examples.zh: 碼頭工人無預警發起的突擊式罷工，給整座港口的貨物裝卸作業帶來了大範圍的癱瘓與混亂。

examples.en: High-grade copper and silicon are essential raw materials for chipmaking.
examples.zh: 高純度銅材與矽晶圓是製造半導體晶片不可或缺的關鍵原物料。

examples.en: Spikes in the global prices of raw materials have squeezed profit margins for manufacturers.
examples.zh: 全球大宗原物料價格的急遽飆升，嚴重壓縮了各大下游製造商的獲利利潤空間。

examples.en: The developing nation relies heavily on exporting raw materials like iron ore and timber.
examples.zh: 這個發展中國家的國家外匯收益高度仰賴鐵礦砂與原木等天然初級原物料的出口。

examples.en: High-precision electronic components are assembled inside clean rooms.
examples.zh: 高精密電子零組件均在無塵室環境內進行組裝與封測。

examples.en: Trust and honest communication are vital components of any healthy working relationship.
examples.zh: 互相信任與誠懇透明的溝通，是維繫任何健康良好工作合作關係最不可或缺的基石。

examples.en: The automobile repair technician replaced a faulty mechanical component in the braking system.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師迅速拆卸並更換了煞車制動系統中出現疲勞受損的故障機械零組件。

words.definition: 組裝生產線；裝配流水線

examples.en: Robotic arms work alongside technicians on the automated assembly line.
examples.zh: 機械手臂在全自動化組裝生產線上與工程技師緊密協同作業。

examples.en: Henry Ford famously revolutionized factory manufacturing by introducing the moving assembly line.
examples.zh: 亨利·福特引進了現代化的移動式組裝流水線，徹底革新了工業工廠的大規模量產模式。

examples.en: Workers monitor each station on the assembly line to prevent defective items from moving forward.
examples.zh: 作業工人在流水線的各個站點嚴密把關，堅決防止任何有瑕疵的半成品流入下一道工序。

words.definition: 前置交期時間；交貨週期

examples.en: Ordering custom parts early shortens manufacturing lead time considerably.
examples.zh: 提前預訂客製化零件能大幅縮短整體產品的製造交期時間。

examples.en: Because of the global container crunch, shipping lead time extended from two weeks to two months.
examples.zh: 由於全球海運貨櫃嚴重短缺，這批貨物的海上運送交貨週期由兩週拉長到了整整兩個月。

examples.en: Improving factory scheduling allowed the company to cut order lead time by forty percent.
examples.zh: 精進工廠排程排班管理，使該製造大廠成功將客戶訂單的生產前置時間大幅削減了四成。

examples.en: The popular ergonomic office chair is temporarily out of stock.
examples.zh: 那款熱銷的人體工學辦公椅目前庫存售罄、暫時缺貨中。

examples.en: I wanted to buy that new novel, but the bookstore owner said it was completely out of stock.
examples.zh: 我原本想購買那本剛出版的暢銷小說，但書店老闆告知我目前全店已經完全斷貨。

examples.en: Customers can register their email address to be notified when the item is no longer out of stock.
examples.zh: 喜愛的顧客可於官方網頁留下電子信箱，以便在商品補貨到庫不再缺貨時第一時間收到通知。

words.definition: 缺貨待補訂單；延期交貨

examples.en: The newest gaming console was placed on backorder due to high demand.
examples.zh: 由於市場需求空前熱烈，最新款遊戲主機已改為缺貨待補預購。

examples.en: Our customer service team notified all buyers that backordered items will ship in three weeks.
examples.zh: 我們的客服團隊逐一致電通知所有買家，目前待補出貨的商品預計將於三週後陸續發貨。

examples.en: The online store does not charge your credit card until the backordered merchandise is ready to ship.
examples.zh: 該線上電商平台採取良善政策，直到缺貨待補的預購商品完全備妥準備寄出時才會正式扣款。

examples.en: Corporate buyers receive a 15% wholesale discount on bulk orders.
examples.zh: 企業採購客戶進行大宗批量訂購時享有八五折的批發優惠。

examples.en: The university placed a bulk order for five hundred office desks and swivel chairs.
examples.zh: 這所大學總務處一口氣大宗採購下訂了五百套辦公書桌與活動旋轉椅。

examples.en: Placing a bulk order helps businesses reduce per-unit shipping fees and packaging waste.
examples.zh: 採取大宗下單策略有助於企業顯著攤提單件商品的物流運送費用並減少包裝耗材浪費。

examples.en: The factory set a minimum order quantity (MOQ) of 500 units for custom logos.
examples.zh: 原廠針對客製化印刷商標設定了五百件的最低起訂量（MOQ）。

examples.en: Small retail startups often struggle to satisfy the high minimum order quantity required by overseas manufacturers.
examples.zh: 初創期的小型零售品牌往往很難達到海外大廠所開出的高門檻最低起訂量限制。

examples.en: You can negotiate a lower minimum order quantity if you agree to pay a slightly higher unit price.
examples.zh: 若您願意在單價上做出適度讓步接受稍高的報價，通常有機會與廠家協商調降最低起訂量。

examples.en: Please send an official price quotation for two thousand wireless headphones.
examples.zh: 請針對兩千副無線耳機提供一份正式的商業價格報價單。

examples.en: The sales executive prepared a comprehensive quotation detailing insurance, freight, and tax costs.
examples.zh: 業務經理準備了一份鉅細靡遺的完整報價單，清楚詳列了海運保險費、運費與各項關稅。

examples.en: Every formal project proposal should be accompanied by a competitive and itemized price quotation.
examples.zh: 每份正式的工程專案投標企劃書，都應當檢附一份具市場競爭力且分項清晰的正式價格報價單。

examples.en: The supplier quoted us a competitive price including shipping insurance.
examples.zh: 供應商向我們提出了一個包含運費與貨物保險的極具競爭力報價。

examples.en: Can you quote me an estimated timeline for developing this customized software application?
examples.zh: 您能否為我們開發這款客製化商務應用軟體報出一個預估的工期時間表？

examples.en: The guest speaker liked to quote famous proverbs from Confucius during his lectures.
examples.zh: 那位受邀講座演講者在學術演講中，特別喜歡隨口引用孔子流傳千古的經典哲理名言。

examples.en: Ordering in larger volumes lowers the individual unit price.
examples.zh: 提高單次下單採購數量能有效壓低各單項產品的平均單價。

examples.en: The purchasing manager bargained hard to reduce the component unit price by five cents.
examples.zh: 採購部經理在談判桌上據理力爭，全力將每只零件的採購單價壓低了五美分。

examples.en: Check the receipt to verify whether the billed unit price matches the promotional catalog.
examples.zh: 請仔細核對收銀結帳單據，確認結帳系統所收取的單價是否與特惠促銷型錄標示相符。

words.definition: 付款條件；付款方式條款

examples.en: Standard international payment terms include 30% deposit and 70% upon shipment.
examples.zh: 標準國際貿易付款條件包括三成訂金與出貨時支付七成尾款。

examples.en: The buyer requested more favorable payment terms of net sixty days to ease cash flow.
examples.zh: 買方為了舒緩公司短期現金流週轉壓力，懇切提出放寬為六十天期付款條件的請求。

examples.en: Before signing any binding supply agreement, always scrutinize the penalty clauses and payment terms.
examples.zh: 在正式簽署任何具法律約束力的供貨合約之前，務必仔細審閱各項違約罰則與付款條款。

examples.en: Banks guarantee export payments securely using documentary letters of credit.
examples.zh: 銀行運用跟單信用狀（L/C）為出口商提供穩健有保障的付款擔保。

examples.en: The buyer's bank issued an irrevocable letter of credit to ensure seamless international trade.
examples.zh: 買方往來銀行開立了一紙不可撤銷信用狀（L/C），以確保整趟跨國貿易交易順利推進。

examples.en: Exporters must submit accurate shipping documents before the letter of credit expires.
examples.zh: 出口廠商必須在信用狀規定的有效履約期限截止前，迅速提交毫無缺漏的整套船務單證。

examples.en: The overseas client sent the balance payment via international wire transfer (TT).
examples.zh: 海外客戶透過國際電匯（TT）將合約尾款全額匯出結清。

examples.en: Wire transfers are commonly used for large commercial transactions because they are rapid and secure.
examples.zh: 由於電子電匯快速且高度安全，因此在各類大宗商業跨國交易中被極其廣泛地採用。

examples.en: Please double-check the recipient's SWIFT code and account number before authorizing the wire transfer.
examples.zh: 在確認授權執行跨國電匯扣款前，請務必再三核對受款銀行的 SWIFT 代碼與受款帳號。

examples.en: Exporters use currency contracts to guard against foreign exchange fluctuations.
examples.zh: 外銷出口商透過遠期外匯合約以防範外匯匯率劇烈波動的風險。

examples.en: Violent fluctuations in global crude oil prices affect international aviation and transportation costs.
examples.zh: 國際原油市場價格的劇烈跌宕波動，直接牽動著全球航空業與貨運物流業的營運成本。

examples.en: Seasonal temperature fluctuations can impact the delicate flowering cycles of highland fruit orchards.
examples.zh: 季節更迭之際氣溫的急劇劇烈起伏，可能會嚴重衝擊高山果園嬌貴果樹的花期孕蕾。

examples.en: Financial hedging strategies protect overseas profits from currency risks.
examples.zh: 妥善的財務避險策略能保護海外營業利潤免受匯差虧損侵蝕。

examples.en: Major commercial airlines engage in fuel price hedging to stabilize operational operating expenditures.
examples.zh: 大型民航航空公司普遍採取燃油價格避險避險操作，以穩定全年的飛航營運成本支出。

examples.en: By using futures contracts as a hedging instrument, the agricultural cooperative mitigated commodity price drops.
examples.zh: 農業產銷合作社善用期貨契約作為風險避險金融工具，成功化解了大宗農作物價格崩跌的危機。

examples.en: The trade dispute was resolved amicably through mutual negotiation.
examples.zh: 這起跨國貿易糾紛透過雙方友好協商得到了圓滿圓融的化解。

examples.en: The two neighboring countries engaged in a protracted territorial dispute over offshore fishing rights.
examples.zh: 兩個相鄰的沿海國家為了近海經濟海域的捕魚權益，陷入了長年僵持不下的領土爭端。

examples.en: Clear contractual wording helps prevent costly legal disputes between business partners.
examples.zh: 嚴謹清晰的合約條款遣詞用字，有助於預先防杜商業合作夥伴之間勞民傷財的法律爭議。

examples.en: Both companies agreed to submit their contractual disagreements to international arbitration.
examples.zh: 兩家公司同意將合約履約爭議提交國際商務仲裁法庭進行公正裁決。

examples.en: Commercial arbitration offers a private and faster alternative to courtroom litigation.
examples.zh: 相較於曠日費時且公諸於世的法院訴訟，商務仲裁程序提供了高度隱密且更有效率的解決方案。

examples.en: The arbitration tribunal rendered a legally binding ruling that both parties were required to honor.
examples.zh: 仲裁法庭做出了具備法律約束力的最終裁決，要求爭議雙方均必須嚴格遵守並履行。
